first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, and the inherited pricing result indicates meaningful acquisition and revenue lift in that segment. I would verify the archived pricing record because its pooled cohort redefinition may affect confidence and targeting. I would also verify onboarding evidence to compare whether the completion decline is likely a more durable revenue constraint. Pricing should be tested with qualification and post-promotion retention/payback guardrails to avoid buying low-value or churn-prone demand.
